Apply Now
Request Info
Plan Your Visit

Register for Transfer Extravaganza

Ready to make your move to UNT? Join us for Transfer Extravaganza Nov. 20 to connect with fellow transfer students, explore resources, get your questions answered and find everything you need to make your transition to UNT a success!
Register Now
Apply to UNT
Take a Tour

At the University of North Texas, your success is our commitment. We know your degree isn't your destination – it's your launchpad. With advisors, mentors and faculty dedicated to championing your goals, you'll open doors to bigger opportunities, bolder dreams and the freedom to build the life you want.

This is where you rise. Better Look North.

Explore Our Programs About UNT 2030

 

Undergraduate Students

Our 111 bachelor’s degrees offer hands-on experience and curriculum shaped through industry partnership so you can develop the skills you need to thrive in your career. 

Explore Majors at UNT

Graduate Students

As an R1 research university with 119 master’s and doctoral degrees, UNT offers unparalleled opportunities to work alongside some of the most cited faculty experts in the nation.

Find Your Graduate Program

Advancing Opportunities

UNT ranks 26th in the nation for social mobility and was named in the nation’s Top 100 for students graduating with the least debt by U.S. News & World Report.
North Texas Promise
Braven Career Accelerator at UNT

Developing Talent

At UNT, you’ll graduate with more than just a degree. You’ll be prepared to lead with direction, confidence and drive.
Visit the Career Center

Discovering Insights

As the largest R1 research university in North Texas, UNT is a powerful engine of discovery and innovation, driving new knowledge and insights that bridge traditional academic disciplines.
Learn more about UNT research

Driving North Texas

UNT’s focus on innovation and entrepreneurship powers the creative economy of the North Texas region and is vital for our region’s global leadership in business, technology, manufacturing and the arts.

Read more UNT News
Learn about the Texas Talent Accelerator
Our Impact
UNT is the largest university in Dallas-Fort Worth — one of the most dynamic regions in the world. Through its campuses in Denton and Frisco, Texas, UNT serves more than 42,000 students with 230 degree programs and awarded more than 13,000 degrees last year.

Academics & Research

  • Ranked an R1 research university by the Carnegie Classification
  • Named a top college for enrolling transfer students by U.S. News & World Report

Affordability

  • Annually awards more than $526 million in financial aid and $83 million in scholarships
  • Ranked in the nation’s Top 100 for students graduating with the least debt by U.S. News & World Report

Vibrant Community

  • Located in Denton, one of the best college towns in the nation
  • 480,000 alumni strong with 324,000 living and working in Dallas-Fort Worth

Soar Higher at UNT
